comment: Art. 24.6/24.7/24.8 GAV and Art. 5.2 und 5.3 des GAV were cut at the article number and labelled BARE_ARTICLE; the GAV is a named instrument -> CONTRACT_ARTICLE. Art. 15 (Der GAV enthalte in Art. 15) stays BARE_ARTICLE because no instrument follows the number. Outcome: two appeals with different results (item 1 Beschwerde in Zivilsachen nicht eingetreten, item 2 Verfassungsbeschwerde abgewiesen) -> first item, inadmissible. Header role word is Beschwerdeführer although the party is female; kept as written.
